```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(tmap)
```

Load the data:

```{r}
cre_sf <- st_read("../data/processed/london_cre_2023_spatial.gpkg", quiet = TRUE)
```

Process:

```{r}
cre_unique <- cre_sf %>%
  group_by(postcode) %>%
  summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(log_price = log(median_price))

cat("Number of unique spatial CRE locations:", nrow(cre_unique), "\n")
```

Clusters in space:

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(cre_unique) +
  tm_dots(col = "log_price", 
          style = "quantile", 
          palette = "Viridis", 
          title = "Log(Median Price)",
          size = 0.5,
          alpha = 0.8) +
  tm_layout(title = "London CRE Volatility Clusters (2023)")
```

Moran's I with KNN to show spatial autocorrelation.

```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(cre_unique)

knn_5 <- knearneigh(coords, k = 5)
nb_5 <- knn2nb(knn_5)

listw_5 <- nb2listw(nb_5, style = "W")

moran_result <- moran.test(cre_unique$log_price, listw_5)
print(moran_result)
```
